reason: A DSH plugin that connects the local tokensave semantic graph engine through its CLI, automatically indexes project directories, and exposes semantic code exploration tools to the agent.

summaries.zh: 通过 tokensave CLI 为 DSH 智能体提供本地项目语义索引和代码关系查询工具。
summaries.en: Connects the tokensave CLI to DSH to provide local semantic project indexing and code relationship queries for the agent.

capabilities: Executes the configured tokensave command-line binary
Indexes and reads project files into a local semantic graph
Runs semantic code exploration tools such as search, callers, callees, and body
May create or synchronize a .tokensave index
Checks crates.io for tokensave updates at startup
